in_marathi.name: Kamalkant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of lotus
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalkant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamalkant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Kamal' (lotus) and 'Kant' (God). It refers to the God who resides in the lotus flower. In Hindu mythology, Kamalkant is often depicted as Vishnu or Krishna holding a lotus flower.
